description: YHTape-2022FL Fluorocarbon film butyl tape is a weather-resistant, self-adhesive waterproof sealing tape. It consists of a surface layer made of fluorocarbon film, backed by a highly aggressive butyl-based pressure-sensitive adhesive.
whereToUse: Seal for the lap edge of exposed waterproofing membrane
Provide protection for the all kind of roof detailing areas

Provide protection for non-roof detailing area, such as window and door openings, corner boards, wall-to-wall tie-ins, sheathing panel seams, deck-to-wall intersections, foundation/sill capillary break
Applications include sealing cracks, terminating waterproofing systems, providing lap joints, and serving as a protective, weather-resistant layer
advantages: Fluorocarbon weathering film has excellent weather resistance and can be used for exposed areas for more than 15 years

Reflective surface film: The white fluorocarbon film significantly reflects solar radiation energy, capable of reducing roof temperature by about 10°C ~ 35°C in hot climates, thereby reducing cooling energy consumption
Superior adhesion: The tape bonds firmly to substrates and forms high quality laps
Heat Resistance: Specially formulated, the tape withstands prolonged exposure to temperatures up to 100℃ without degradation of the butyl adhesive
Superior flexibility at low temperature: Maintains good flexibility even at -40°C
Can heal nail shank damage with a diameter of less than 2mm
notFor: The base surface must be dry during construction. Construction is strictly prohibited on rainy or snowy days, as well as on windy days with wind speeds exceeding level 5
If the construction temperature is below 5°C, initial adhesion may be insufficient
The substrate surface must be thoroughly cleaned and shall be solid, flat, dry, and free of debris, dust, dirt, loose nails, or old roofing materials

standards.value: Adhesion to plywood and to steel

technicalData.label: Adhesion to plywood at 23 °C, N/mm (ASTM D903)
Adhesion to steel at 23 °C, N/mm (ASTM D903)
Peel strength of lap, N/mm (ASTM D1876)

packaging: Width / mm 80 mm, 100 mm, or 330 mm; Thickness / mm 0.8 mm, 1.0 mm; Length / m 10 m, 20 m
storage: The product should be stored in a cool, well-ventilated, and dry warehouse, protected from rain, sunlight, and fire sources. The storage temperature should be between 5°C and 35°C. Under normal storage and transportation conditions, the shelf life is 24 months.
